notes.title: Major update: v1.2 "Remastered" is now live.
notes.notes:
Greetings players and future players,

Since release, we've spent time hanging out with players and watching streamers play. This has been an invaluable source of feedback! One common observation has been that, artistically speaking, the game seems to hark back to some retro era that didn't actually exist: This is a reality about Goldenheart that will never really change and was only somewhat intentional.

However, this update attempts to bring the style of the game together into a more cohesive package by altering the render pipeline at each step of the way:

[list]
[*] The textures have been reduced from 2k to 512, reducing the overall size of the game by about 1GB.

[*] Unreal Engine's cutting edge downsampling/upsampling pipeline with TSR antialiasing has been replaced with a more traditional pipeline which renders the game at full 3D resolution and applies good old Fast Approximate antialiasing at the end.

[*] In post process, the pixel resolution is then decreased, and colors are reduced all the way down to 16 before dithering, which creates the illusion of increasing the colors again - very old-school but also somewhat trendy at present.

[*] The UI has also been overhauled to match the new look, and each game level has been adjusted and tweaked as well.

[*] A gamma/brightness slider has been added to the graphics settings, allowing us to push the overall contrast and lighting effects per level to a more extreme degree, increasing ambiance and variety.
[/list]

As the co-creator of the game, let me just say this: This is kind of what I always wanted for the game, but it's taken some research and development to make it happen in a way that we're happy with, so I'm glad we didn't rush it. Unfortunately, these changes run deep, making it impractical to toggle between versions at runtime.

I understand that some or perhaps many players will prefer the previous high-resolution graphics, which is why I've created a new branch called "Legacy" which will continue to host v1.1.2 permanently.
To access the Legacy branch: Select Goldenheart in your steam library, click the gear icon -> properties -> betas -> beta participation: select Legacy from the drop-down. 

Please drop by our Discord and let us know what you think!

Thanks for all your support,
Kippercans
Millenniapede Audio Video Club

notes.title: Goldenheart Original Soundtrack
notes.notes:
The Goldenheart OST is now available for purchase on the store page!

The Goldenheart OST contains all 37 individual tracks included in the game. The tracks have been trimmed to normal and short lengths, trying to maintain the essence of each track. The total playtime is about 1 hour and 40 minutes and the order of the songs mimic the progression of the game. All music was created in-house by the Millenniapede Audio Video Club specifically for Goldenheart.

notes.title: Major Update
notes.notes:
[u][b]V1.1 notable changes:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Steam’s Cloud Saves system has been enabled.
[*] Steam Achievements have been implemented throughout the game.
[*] The Poetry Books written about the winners of the Launch Contest have been hidden in various places.
[*] No spoilers but the endgame cutscenes have been completely overhauled.
[*] Several levels have received minor changes, improvements, and bug fixes.
[/list]
[u][b]Difficulty settings changes:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] The difficulty settings (previously experimental) have been finalized down to three settings. If you were playing on one of the “in-between” settings your current setting will be rounded up or down so please check on the pause menu to make sure you are where you want to be.
[*] Story Mode: 0.5x incoming damage, right in between the old “easier” settings. Monster spawn changes carried from previous “Story Mode.”
[*] Normal Mode: previously “adventure mode” - no modifier, default spawns.
[*] Souls Mode: The same as “Master Mode” but without restricting its selection to game slot creation.
[/list]
[u][b]Other notable changes and fixes:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Running out of stamina will no longer prevent you from using the sword, but using the sword will still drain stamina.
[*] Slow moving projectiles and homing projectiles can now be targeted.
[*] The Save Slots now show how many out of 16 possible health upgrades have been found.
[*] The player’s blocking detection for high-velocity projectiles has been improved to avoid an error that can occur when blocking Skeleton Archer arrows near the outer extent of their range.
[*] A bug that caused Stalagmite damage to the player to be triggered multiple times on a single contact has been fixed (effectively reducing the damage)
[/list]

notes.title: v1.012 patch - Air control and Melee Overhaul
notes.notes:
This update has been in the works for some time but was kept separate from yesterday's patch to help keep us from getting our wires crossed. These changes introduce several new features "under the hood" to help to make the game play more smoothly.

[i]Please let us know if you encounter any bugs![/i]

[b]Air control added to jumping and falling physics:[/b]
This makes all of the platforming a bit more forgiving, especially on jumps with odd angles or distances to cover, because you can continue to navigate somewhat while airborne.

[b]Melee overhaul:[/b]
[list]
[*] The range of the sword has been increased.
[*] The accuracy of the sword attacks have been improved to avoid hitting walls etc while aiming at enemies etc.
[*] You can no longer attack with the sword while your stamina is depleted.
[*] Sword attacks now consume stamina, the amount depends on which sword you have.
[*] Dodging now consumes less stamina, in order to compensate for the attack cost.
[*] Block input can no longer interrupt a sword attack before the hit check begins.
[*] An input buffer will now re-trigger blocking if the block button is held after stamina regeneration or a committed sword attack has done a hit check.
[*] Another input buffer will now queue consecutive sword attacks when the input is received before the current sword attack reaches it's hit check, without interrupting the current sword attack.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.007 patch - Emergency bug fix - Sorry!
notes.notes:
We discovered that our patch v1.005 on December 1st introduced a pretty serious bug that caused many doors in the game to save as "Opened" whenever the level was reloaded after reaching a save point.

The bug has been fixed but if you are already part way through a level those doors could still be missing. You should be able to finish and the next level will be back to normal. 

If you got stuck in the maze in Nyvena because of this bug, the Red Door will unlock itself after 1.5 seconds.

Its possible that you have experienced this bug without noticing, and it's also possible that you played through without actually being affected by the bug because it is limited to certain areas and circumstances.

If your save data gets you stuck anywhere in the game, don't start over! Please let us know and we'll get it fixed as quickly as possible.

Thanks for your patience!!

notes.title: Demo Updated!
notes.notes:
We'd like to thank everyone who has tried our demo so far and especially those who have gone out of their way to provide feedback! 

We've got our work cut out for us for in the coming weeks but there were a few popular requests that we were able to fulfill on the fly.

Namely,

[b]-The tutorial level has been removed from the demo. [/b]*
[i]It is a very simplistic tutorial and many players don't need it when the controls are available for reference on the pause menu, preferring expedited access to the actual gameplay.[/i] 

*this could corrupt your save slot if you already created it but never completed the tutorial. Simply delete your slot and create a new one.

[b]
-The archery animations have been updated and fixed.[/b]
[i]The alignment of the arrow when nocked has been centered and no longer fluctuates from side to side with the characters' movement.[/i]

[b]-A small crosshair has been added to the HUD[/b]
[i]Mostly to improve the ability to aim the arrows but we are trying out having it displayed at all times, since it also accurately represents the sword sweeps and invisible traces for the action button.[/i]
[b]
-The velocity of the arrow has been more than doubled.[/b]
[i]This is a parameter we play around with a lot. We use a very realistic physics equation for the arrow. The question remains, how reealistic do we want the bow to be? The 3d model is based off an ancient scythian hunting bow which, in reality, wouldn't have a huge amount of power. However, In my personal testing, I am finding the higher velocity arrows to be more fun and easier to aim. [/i]

[b]-The rate of fire has also been slightly increased for archery.[/b]

***

[b]The URL for demo feedback form: (there's also a button within the demo to access this form)[/b]

[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/11uqCfPCAYlyjbRkK2Ak-54b2JIBMcdaqnf0hzTlhhak/viewform?edit_requested=true]google form: demo feedback[/url]
